svg.title: KS-08 animated top view
svg.desc: Synthetic (DSR-12), no evidence credit. Looping top view of KS-08 (Lead decelerating hard) from its esmini replay at the parameter defaults, 0.0 to 6.2 s: The lead brakes hard at 5 m/s² from a 1.5 s gap. Plot: gap to the lead (m). Events: lead brakes at 5 m/s² at 3.0 s; loop ends before overlap at 6.2 s. Layer 2 fixes the road and the other road users. The ego only holds its start speed here; the item under test drives it in layer 1 and on the bench, so the loop ends before the bodies overlap. Cars: Kenney Racing Pack (CC0).
svg.text: The lead brakes hard at 5 m/s² from a 1.5 s gap
